not_exported.detail: Fleet's built-in skills (presentation-builder, svg-builder, mermaid-diagram-builder, generate-skill, fleet-guide and others) ship with Fleet's runtime. The exported agent doesn't have them.
Fleet's shared Slack app isn't exported; run `mda channels init slack` to deploy the agent's own Slack app

left_behind: Conversations: past threads stay in Fleet. The deployment starts with none.
Traces: the deployment traces to a new LangSmith project. Past traces stay in the Fleet agent's project.
memory: `memory.py` gives the agent its own memory in `memories/agent/`. It starts empty, and the agent adds to it as it learns.
